$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFMQ (AIP France, chart dated 2026-03-19): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Castellet

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

service.atsHours: ETE / SUM : 0700-1600. HIV / WIN : 0800-1600. +33 4 94 98 39 35 afis@aeroportducastellet.com (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : - 1 HR)

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
AD prohibited to gliders.
AD prohibited to ACFT (except HEL) if crosswind higher than 15 kt.
Possible IFR operations.
Except for based ACFT authorized by AD operator, use of RWY 12/30 prohibited outside AFIS SKED.
High-visibility vest mandatory on runway side.
Runway inspection during ATS SKED only.
Possible restrictions of aerial activities during events on Paul Ricard circuit.
Flight intentions for ACFT with mandatory flight plans via: business aviation flights: https://cy.myhandlingsoftware.com; general aviation flights: https://www.touchngo.fr.
If strong wind from NW, possibility of turbulences on final APCH.
By sea breeze (wind from SSW) and in case of uncertainly about wind direction indication, use RWY 30.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
Possible brown out due to propeller and blade blast (possible presence of dust on the airfield).
Possible bird hazard on the airfield and its immediate vicinity.
Aerobatics (NR 6965): see AIP ENR 5.5 Radio contact mandatory even before engine run up or engine tests.
Circling training on request by TEL: +33 4 94 98 39 35.
Training, go-around, touch and go, traffic pattern prohibited outside ATS SKED and between 1100-1200 (SUM: -1HR).
For IFR training: see eAIP.
Overflying of race course prohibited, below 1500 ft AAL.
Protection against obstacles limited at 7 km for PAPI RWY 12 and 30.
Day and night, compulsory use of PAPI on RWY 30.
PAPI 30 in use during AFIS SKED only.
RWY 12 and 30: TKOF compulsory from THR.
H24 JET A1-AVGAS 100LL automated fuel dispenser payment by operator badge or credit card only.
Refueling truck JET A1 ATS SKED: payment by credit card or cash.
Lubrifiants / Lubricants: NIL.
Niveau 5 / Level 5 pendant HOR ATS / during ATS SKED.
Niveau 1 / Level 1 hors HOR ATS / outside ATS SKED.
Lake rescue 1 boat + 2 lifeboats (60 seats).
Péril animalier / Wildlife strike hazard: Occasionnel / Random.
